Fit the recommended longitudinal GAMLSS-copula workflow

Source: R/adoption_workflow.R
fit_longitudinal.Rd

`fit_longitudinal()` is a golden-path wrapper around [gamlss.longitudinal()] with adoption-friendly defaults. It optionally screens the copula family from a pseudo-observation column and stores workflow metadata on the fitted object.

Usage

fit_longitudinal(
  dataset,
  margin_dist,
  time_var,
  subject_var,
  mu.formula,
  sigma.formula = ~1,
  nu.formula = ~1,
  tau.formula = ~1,
  theta.formula = ~1,
  zeta.formula = ~1,
  copula_dist = NULL,
  auto_select_copula = TRUE,
  u_var = NULL,
  copula_families = c("N", "C", "F", "G", "J", "t"),
  run_checks = TRUE,
  method = "RS",
  include_dlcopdpar = TRUE,
  compute_vcov = FALSE,
  warm_start_joint = FALSE,
  verbose = 0,
  ...
)

Arguments

dataset

Long-format data frame.

margin_dist

Marginal `gamlss.dist` family object.

time_var, subject_var

Column names identifying time and subject.

mu.formula

Formula for the marginal location/mean parameter.

sigma.formula, nu.formula, tau.formula

Marginal parameter formulas.

theta.formula, zeta.formula

Copula parameter formulas.

copula_dist

Optional copula family code. If `NULL`, `fit_longitudinal()` selects from `u_var` when available, otherwise uses `"N"` as a conservative default.

auto_select_copula

Logical; when `TRUE` and pseudo-observations are available, call [select_copula()].

u_var

Optional pseudo-observation column used for copula screening. If omitted and `dataset` has a column named `"u"`, that column is used.

copula_families

Candidate copula family codes for screening.

run_checks

Logical; attach `check_model(..., include_plots = FALSE)` to the returned object.

method, include_dlcopdpar, compute_vcov, verbose

Defaults passed to [gamlss.longitudinal()].

warm_start_joint

Logical; default `FALSE` for the high-level workflow because it favors reliability over a faster but more fragile warm-start phase. Advanced users can set this to `TRUE`.

...

Additional arguments passed to [gamlss.longitudinal()].

Value

A fitted `gamlss.longitudinal` object with a `workflow` component.
